description: AUTHORITATIVE for Czech company identity — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "who is IČO 00177041", "is this Czech company still active", "what is Škoda Auto's VAT number". Looks up one economic subject in the Czech Ministry of Finance ARES register by its IČO (8-digit company id) and returns the registered trading name, legal form, registered seat address, founding date, dissolution date if any, the DIČ (VAT) number, and the CZ-NACE activity codes.

ico.description: Czech IČO (identifikační číslo osoby), 8 digits. Leading zeros optional — "177041" and "00177041" both work, e.g. "00177041" (Škoda Auto a.s.).
